description: This PHP class defines a decorator for the ProjectActivity entity within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to associate a project with a specific activity, encapsulating additional behavior and referencing entities.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class to add behavior to the ProjectActivity entity, including setting the related Project by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a ProjectActivity instance.

methods.name: setProjectById
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with the ProjectActivity based on the provided project ID.
